name: Bokura no Hyaku Monogatari - Mamagoto no Rougoku Hen
original_name: ぼくらの百物語 ままごとの牢獄篇
source:
When I got caught shoplifting, I met a strange girl. She could take care of anything unpleasant, even things bordering on criminal acts. But there was no sweet, happy ending to this story. (The Girl Who Takes the Blame)
The game started by a transfer student turned everyone into an exact copy of her—a cursed game. (Infectious Plague Girl)
A game that filled everyone with terror, yet no one could stop playing. What is the truth behind the Tomb Ghost? (The Graveyard Game)

This is the second installment of the Hyakumonogatari series, featuring nine completely original scary stories plus one title story that unlocks by listening to a specific tale—totaling ten stories.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371561]booth[/url]]
translation:
当我入店行窃被抓时，我遇到了一个奇怪的女孩。她可以处理任何不愉快的事情，甚至是近乎犯罪行为的事情。但这个故事并没有甜蜜、幸福的结局。（承担责任的女孩）转学生发起的游戏让所有人都变成了她的复制品——一场被诅咒的游戏。（传染性瘟疫少女）一款让所有人都充满恐惧的游戏，但却没有人能够停止玩。古墓鬼魂背后的真相是什么？（墓地游戏）这是百物语系列的第二部，包含九个完全原创的恐怖故事，加上一个通过聆听特定故事来解锁的同名故事，总共十个故事。

[翻译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371561]booth[/url]]
